en.headline: Lee names finance, technology and education as key growth drivers ahead of five-year plan
en.dek: Chief Executive John Lee said the city’s first five-year plan would set broad strategies aligning with the national 15th five-year plan, while the Policy Address would focus on concrete measures.
body: Chief Executive John Lee Ka-chiu on Saturday identified financial services, innovation and technology, and education as three key new growth drivers ahead of the release of Hong Kong’s first five-year development blueprint and the annual Policy Address.

In a video posted on social media, Lee said the five-year plan would outline broad strategies, set clear development directions and align with the nation’s 15th five-year plan. The Policy Address would focus on specific measures. The two documents were closely linked and mutually reinforcing, he said.

Lee highlighted four initiatives that had injected new momentum: ensuring the effective operation of the central gold clearing system; developing a commodities trading ecosystem; attracting leading global enterprises to the Hong Kong-Shenzhen Innovation and Technology Park in the Lok Ma Chau Loop; and developing a university town in the Northern Metropolis.

He said the government would remain pragmatic, continue to unleash market vitality and constantly cultivate new growth drivers for Hong Kong. Both the five-year plan and the Policy Address are scheduled for publication on 16 September.

zh.headline: 李家超：金融、創科、教育為五年規劃三大新增長動力
zh.dek: 行政長官在社交平台表示，首份五年規劃將訂立宏觀策略並對接國家「十五五」，施政報告則聚焦具體措施，兩者一脈相承。
body: 行政長官李家超今日在社交平台發布影片，指出在編制及落實施政報告措施下，政府持續在金融、創科、教育等多方面發力，為香港帶來新動力、新機會。
他表示，《香港第一個五年規劃》將為香港制定宏觀策略並明確發展方向，主動對接國家「十五五」規劃；而《施政報告》則聚焦落實各項規劃的具體措施，兩者一脈相承。
李家超提到四項已注入新動力的工作，包括確保黃金中央結算系統有效運作、構建大宗商品交易生態圈、持續吸引全球前沿企業進駐河套香港園區，以及建設北都大學城，全力打造國際專上教育樞紐。
他強調，特區政府有信心透過長遠規劃與具體落實，持續激發市場活力，為香港不斷開拓新增長點。五年規劃及施政報告將於本月16日同日公布。
